title: Latent-Space Intervention for Cross-Lingual Factual Consistency: Consistency Improvements without Accuracy Drops
abstract: arXiv:2608.28860v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often answer the same factual question differently across languages. We study whether cross-lingual latent-space intervention can reduce this inconsistency. We train layer-specific autoencoders on parallel multilingual representations and apply inference-time corrections to factual QA prompts. We find that latent intervention improves geometric alignment between languages, and that this improvement translates into consistent gains in cross-lingual consistency with English across both open-ended and multiple-choice QA formats, without degrading factual accuracy. In open-ended QA, Spearman's rank correlation between English and non-English languages improves substantially, with gains of 0.16 for English-Arabic and 0.20 for English-Russian pairs. In multiple-choice QA, answer agreement with English improves consistently across both KLAR and mParaRel. Ablations show that AE reconstruction yields consistent gains

translated_title: 潜空间干预实现跨语言事实一致性：在不降低准确率的情况下提升一致性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在回答同一个事实性问题时，不同语言下往往会给出不同的答案。我们研究了跨语言潜空间干预能否减少这种不一致性。我们在平行的多语言表示上训练针对特定层的自编码器，并在推理时对事实性问答提示应用校正。我们发现潜空间干预改善了语言之间的几何对齐，并且这种改善转化为在开放式问答和选择题问答两种格式下与英文的跨语言一致性的持续提升，同时不会降低事实准确性。在开放式问答中，英语与非英语语言之间的Spearman等级相关性显著提高，其中英语-阿拉伯语对提升了0.16，英语-俄语对提升了0.20。在选择题问答中，与英语的答案一致性在KLAR和mParaRel两个基准上均持续改善。消融实验表明，自编码器（AE）重构能够带来一致的收益。
tldr: 通过训练针对特定层的自编码器对多语言表示进行潜空间干预，可以在不损失事实准确率的前提下显著提升大语言模型的跨语言事实一致性。
en_tdlr: Latent-space intervention using layer-specific autoencoders significantly improves cross-lingual factual consistency in LLMs without sacrificing factual accuracy.
